services.name: Summer Swim Team
services.desc: Search our activity schedules by age, activity, location, time and more to find what’s right for you. It’s never too late for adults to learn how to swim! Whether you've never had the opportunity to learn or just don’t feel confident in the water, adult swim lessons at the Y are designed to meet you where you are. Certified instructors create a welcoming, judgment-free environment where you can build skills gradually and comfortably. You'll learn water safety, basic to advanced stroke techniques, and how to feel at ease in and around water. services.name: Cooking Programs
services.desc: Search our activity schedules by age, activity, location, time and more to find what’s right for you. Put on your chef’s hat and embark on a delicious adventure with us! We offer a variety of hands-on cooking classes designed to spark creativity, build confidence, and explore the world through food. Classes are offered as a series or one-time events, at both the Framingham Branch and the Hopkinton Outdoor Center. You can choose from parent-child classes, or those for youth, adults, and families!
